## Braintree Marketplace

Braintree Marketplace documentation uses a master-merchant and sub-merchant model. In the collected Node.js onboarding guide, the master merchant creates a merchant account for each sub-merchant and then confirms its creation; new merchants seeking a marketplace solution are directed to Braintree Sales. Treat this as a snapshot-scoped retrieval route, not proof that Marketplace is currently available or that a particular merchant is eligible. [[source-braintree-marketplace-guide-onboarding-node]]

## Onboarding and account boundary

The Node.js guide says individual information is always required and a registered company additionally supplies business information while remaining tied to an individual. Its bank-funding path requires a bank destination and checking-account details, but Braintree says it does not verify those details; a final-disbursement error can trigger a disbursement-exception webhook and held funds until correction. A valid creation result may still show the sub-merchant as `pending`, with status handling and successful-creation confirmation routed to later steps. [[source-braintree-marketplace-guide-onboarding-node]]
